name: Aico Link Firmware
notes: The source lists a firmware overlay, C++ capture and audio services, a Go agent, tests, and benchmark support. It says the target must support video output and USB HID input; iOS control requires AssistiveTouch.
summary: Aico Link firmware runs an agent that views a phone or computer through HDMI capture and sends input through USB HID. The repository includes hardware services, agent runtime, and update tooling.
